Untested ideas: an Arrhenius-type rate in strain such as exp(-q/T) combined with a non-monotone strain term, or a product form in which the strain dependence couples to T.

import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p = params
    s0 = p[0] + p[1]*T + p[2]/T
    Q = p[3] + p[4]*T + p[5]/T
    b = p[6] + p[7]/T
    return s0 + Q*(1-np.exp(-b*eps)) + p[8]*eps + p[9]*np.sqrt(eps)
